description: This file manages email composition within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes functions for initializing full compose windows, generating email data packages for different contexts (full, quick, reply, forward), and handling related data retrieval for quotes and other entities. The file also checks for valid entry points and interacts with beans and templates to facilitate email workflows.

methods.name: initFullCompose
methods.description: Encodes the compose data package as JSON and outputs it for use in creating or updating the compose window.

methods.name: generateComposeDataPackage
methods.description: Creates a data array for email compose screens, handling different contexts such as parent records, reply, forward, and list views, and optionally outputs or returns the data.

methods.name: getQuotesRelatedData
methods.description: Retrieves related data for quote records, including email subject, body, recipients, and parent entity information.
